title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Matthew 8: the leper, the centurion's servant, the storm on the sea and the demons sent into the pigs.

questions.text: What happened immediately after Jesus touched the leper?
questions.explanation: Jesus stretched out his hand, touched him and said he wanted to, and immediately the man's leprosy was cleansed.

answers.text: The multitudes went away
His leprosy was cleansed
He fell asleep at once
The priest came to him

questions.text: What did Jesus tell the cleansed man to do?
questions.explanation: Jesus told him to tell nobody, but to go, show himself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded.

answers.text: Show himself to the priest and offer the gift
Follow him to the other side of the sea
Tell everyone in the city what happened
Stay in the house for seven days

questions.text: Who came to Jesus in Capernaum about a paralyzed servant?
questions.explanation: When Jesus came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him about his servant, who lay in the house paralyzed.

answers.text: A scribe
A ruler
A centurion
A leper

questions.text: What did the centurion say he was not worthy of?
questions.explanation: The centurion said he was not worthy for Jesus to come under his roof, and asked him to just say the word.

answers.text: To be called a son of Abraham
To offer a gift at the altar
To sit at the table with Jesus
For Jesus to come under his roof

questions.text: What did Jesus say about the centurion's faith?
questions.explanation: Jesus marveled and said that he had not found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

answers.text: It was like the faith of Abraham
He had not found such faith, even in Israel
It was small, like a grain of seed
It was the faith of the children of the Kingdom

questions.text: Who was lying sick with a fever in Peter's house?
questions.explanation: When Jesus came into Peter's house, he saw Peter's wife's mother lying sick with a fever, and he touched her hand.

answers.text: Peter's wife's mother
Peter's daughter
A servant of the centurion
The scribe's mother

questions.text: What did Jesus answer the scribe who said he would follow him wherever he went?
questions.explanation: Jesus said that foxes have holes and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.

answers.text: Let him first go and bury his father
He should stay in Capernaum
He has nowhere to lay his head
He must sell his nets first

questions.text: What did Jesus do after the disciples woke him in the storm?
questions.explanation: He asked why they were fearful, then got up and rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

answers.text: He walked out on the water
He told them to row harder
He went back to sleep
He rebuked the wind and the sea

questions.text: Who met Jesus in the country of the Gergesenes, coming out of the tombs?
questions.explanation: Two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce.

answers.text: Two blind men
Two people possessed by demons
A scribe and a centurion
The whole city with torches

questions.text: What happened to the herd of pigs?
questions.explanation: The demons went into the herd of pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.

answers.text: They rushed down the cliff and died in the sea
They were driven away into the tombs
They were kept by those who fed them
They followed Jesus to the other side
